# rail

Rail cards, attention versus manual order, pin, drag reorder, session count.

- Spec: `docs/features/rail/spec.md`
- Contract: `docs/features/rail/contract.md`

## Protocol

- `sessions.pin` — `PUT /api/sessions/{id}/pin`
- `sessions.order` — `PUT /api/sessions/order`

## Decisions

- `kb:adr/actions-placement-mainhead-and-card-rows` — End, Resume and Remove live in a mainhead above the focused terminal and in hover-revealed action rows on rail cards and tile footers, behind confirm dialogs. (accepted, 2026-08-27; features: actions, focus, rail, tiles) → `docs/adr/actions-placement-mainhead-and-card-rows.md`
- `kb:adr/drop-reorder-drag-mime-custom-type` — Internal tile and rail reorder drags carry a Muster-specific MIME type instead of text/plain, so a dragover can tell a reorder from dragged text. (accepted, 2026-09-03; features: drop, rail, tiles) → `docs/adr/drop-reorder-drag-mime-custom-type.md`
- `kb:adr/focus-rail-click-focuses-terminal` — A pointer click on a rail card puts keyboard focus in that session's terminal; keyboard activation, number chords and the Tiles strip only select. (accepted, 2026-09-02; features: focus, rail, surfaces) → `docs/adr/focus-rail-click-focuses-terminal.md`
- `kb:adr/focus-rail-plus-one-live-pane` — The Focus view is a rail of static cards beside exactly one live pane, with account usage in a persistent masthead. (accepted, 2026-08-16; features: focus, rail, usage) → `docs/adr/focus-rail-plus-one-live-pane.md`
- `kb:adr/rail-current-marker-means-shown-in-focus` — The rail marks the session the Focus pane shows with a neutral treatment and aria-current; it never means live in this view, so Tiles renders none. (accepted, 2026-09-03; features: rail, focus) → `docs/adr/rail-current-marker-means-shown-in-focus.md`
- `kb:adr/rail-order-daemon-owned-per-session-fields` — Rail order and pinned state are daemon-owned per-session fields with daemon-held invariants; the daemon persists and broadcasts, the client sorts. (accepted, 2026-08-30; features: rail, lifecycle) → `docs/adr/rail-order-daemon-owned-per-session-fields.md`
- `kb:adr/rail-user-owned-manual-order-default` — The rail has two sort modes: manual, the default, keeps a user-owned pinned-then-positional order; attention is the old needs-input-first sort, kept as a mode. (accepted, 2026-08-30; features: rail, settings) → `docs/adr/rail-user-owned-manual-order-default.md`
- `kb:adr/rail-whole-card-drag-drop-decides-pin` — Rail cards drag by the whole card with insert-and-shift semantics; the drop position decides pin state, and a pin control lifts a card into the pinned block. (accepted, 2026-08-30; features: rail) → `docs/adr/rail-whole-card-drag-drop-decides-pin.md`
- `kb:adr/shortcuts-cmd-n-follows-rail-order` — The number chords select the nth card in the order the rail currently displays, manual or attention, rather than staying attention-ranked. (accepted, 2026-08-30; features: shortcuts, rail) → `docs/adr/shortcuts-cmd-n-follows-rail-order.md`
- `kb:adr/shortcuts-jump-to-neediest-option-command-zero` — Option-Command-0 selects the neediest session by attention priority, ignoring the rail's sort mode and pinned block; no live session is a silent no-op. (accepted, 2026-09-04; features: shortcuts, rail) → `docs/adr/shortcuts-jump-to-neediest-option-command-zero.md`
- `kb:adr/surfaces-one-live-client-per-attach-target` — The one-live-client law is per attach target, not per session: a session's Claude socket and shell socket coexist and never supersede each other. (accepted, 2026-09-05; features: surfaces, tiles, rail) → `docs/adr/surfaces-one-live-client-per-attach-target.md`

## Retired, rejected and superseded

- `kb:adr/nongoal-attention-ribbon-post-v1` — The attention ribbon, a timeline of session events, is not built in v1; the event table already carries what it would need. (rejected, 2026-08-16; features: rail) → `docs/adr/nongoal-attention-ribbon-post-v1.md`
- `kb:adr/nongoal-macos-notifications` — No macOS notifications or other alerts outside the dashboard; the dashboard is the alert surface by design. (rejected, 2026-08-16; features: rail) → `docs/adr/nongoal-macos-notifications.md`
- `kb:adr/rail-attention-sort-order` — The rail sorts by attention: Needs-Input longest-blocked first, then Failed, Planning, Working, Started, Idle longest-idle first. (superseded, 2026-08-16; features: rail) → `docs/adr/rail-attention-sort-order.md`
- `kb:adr/surfaces-one-live-client-per-session` — A session is live on exactly one surface at one geometry at a time; every other rendering of it is a static snapshot. (superseded, 2026-08-16; features: surfaces, tiles, rail) → `docs/adr/surfaces-one-live-client-per-session.md`
